posts.text: There is nothing like the Onion...

I'm detecting a significant shift toward pessimism in both Washington and Tehran just in the last 24 hours. 

Failure to get a deal will be detrimental to both sides. Both will suffer. 

Sadly, that is not necessarily how every faction within the two governments sees it...

BREAKING! 
Iran just struck US targets in Kuwait after the US struck Qeshm today. Also, alarms just went off in Bahrain, seems Iran is striking there too.

Iranian source tells me Iran has stopped playing the tit-for-tat game. Instead, it's now striking back "at least 1.5x as hard" for every attack the US against Iran.
